name: TeamStarWolf - Major Cloud Security Incidents, 2011 to 2026
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified public record of cloud security incidents from 2011 to 2026 supports: the CISA and FBI advisories AA21-008A, AA23-320A and AA24-057A, the CSRB reviews, Microsoft's reports on DEV-0537, Storm-0558, Midnight Blizzard, Storm-3168 and Storm-0940, Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence Group on UNC5537, UNC6040 and UNC6395, the Okta, CircleCI, Codecov, Uber and Capital One records, Wiz on Qubole, Todyl on stolen app secrets, and the ATT&CK objects the study binds. T1562.008 is revoked in v20.0 and is shown as its successor T1685.002 from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CLOUD_SECURITY_INCIDENTS.md. Scores: 100 a source lists the id itself for a dated event, 75 a primary describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the only basis is Reported (T1552.005, Capital One) or detection context (T1685.002).
